title: Luxurious Italian Sausage Suppli
description: A resinous, pillowy, cozy Italian dish featuring Italian fennel sausages, mantecare-emulsify, Whole30-friendly, formed into suppli and served in a dolsot-stone-bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the garlic and onion until softened.
Add the Italian fennel sausages to the skillet and cook, breaking up with a spoon, until no longer pink.
Stir in the cauliflower rice, chicken broth, and grated Parmesan cheese, and cook until the liquid is absorbed.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked sausage mixture, eggs, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small suppli shapes.
Place the suppli in a dolsot-stone-bowl and bake for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Serve the suppli hot, garnished with additional grated Parmesan cheese if desired.
